name: Advanced Sheet Metal
old_description: Precision-fabricated sheet metal products for residential and commercial roofing systems across Arizona.
about:
Advanced Sheet Metal, a family-owned metal fabrication company, was founded in 2006 in Phoenix, Arizona. The business operates manufacturing facilities in both Phoenix and Tucson, serving the Arizona market with precision-fabricated sheet metal components for roofing systems.

The company specializes in standing seam metal roofing panels, custom flashing, coping, trim, soffit systems, and a full range of roofing accessories. Every item is made to specification with flexible options for profiles, colors, gauges, and finishes. Fabrication is performed in-house at its two Arizona plants, though the company does not disclose headcount or annual volume.

Advanced Sheet Metal supplies residential and commercial roofing contractors and builders across Arizona. Its product line is tailored for roofing systems used in both new construction and retrofit projects, with an emphasis on quick turnaround for job-site delivery.

The company emphasizes fast, efficient turnaround times, stating that most orders are fabricated and shipped faster than the industry average without cutting corners. Its family-owned, Arizona-focused structure is presented as a differentiator, allowing direct control over quality and scheduling.
